# sdd-review-gate

Use at the end of every human phase (G1, G2, G3, G4, G6, G7), when an artifact is complete and a gate is next. Runs the review with us in the chat - the agent explains, asks specific questions, applies changes - and stops until we approve at our terminals and `sdd status` shows the gate passed. Never drafts the next artifact before that.

Read `.agents/skills/sdd-review-gate/SKILL.md` and follow it step by step. It is the canonical skill; this file only points to it.
